generic_domain.justification: Deep Learning and Neural Networks form a broad foundational area that underpins many specific applications. They encompass the theoretical models, algorithms, and techniques necessary for processing data in various ways. Since research into deep learning includes both developing new methods (as in 'deep learning and neural networks') as well as applying existing ones to real-world problems ('deep learning applications'), this domain is more general than its application-focused counterpart. Therefore, choosing the former allows us to encompass a wider array of research topics within deep learning.
